content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Payment processors like Stripe and PayPal provide quick integration and user-friendly interfaces, but they come with significant limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving over 70% of the world unable to use their services. PayPal's reputation for holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal adds a layer of risk that many creators cannot afford. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure enables creators from restricted countries to build their own online stores with a complete stack of tools. This includes hosting on Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Workers, and payment processing through NOWPayments, allowing creators to maintain control and ownership of their revenue streams.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy effectively exclude large markets, creating barriers for creators in regions like Ghana and Zimbabwe. They impose geographical restrictions based on arbitrary decisions rather than any inherent limitation of the digital economy. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is designed to operate independently of such restrictions. By utilizing technologies like Google Apps Script and Supabase, creators can bypass these limitations and set up shop on their own terms. This approach not only provides access to a global market but also ensures that payment processing isn’t contingent upon the whims of a platform.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, traditional processors can often take days to settle transactions, especially in restricted regions. Fees also add up quickly, with PayPal charging significant transaction fees on top of currency conversion costs. In contrast, NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a mere 0.5% fee, and transactions on recommended networks like BSC and Solana cost under $0.10. This means that creators can receive funds instantly and retain more of their earnings. Sovereign commerce infrastructure not only speeds up the payment process but also significantly reduces the cost per transaction, allowing creators to keep more of what they earn.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical aspects of selling digital products is ownership. With platforms like PayPal and Stripe, creators often face limitations on data access and control. A sudden account suspension can leave one’s business in limbo. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators own everything after deployment. With tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, product delivery occurs automatically, and full data ownership is guaranteed. This architecture not only protects the creator’s interests but also provides a seamless experience for customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the choice is clear: sovereign commerce infrastructure is the way forward. If you are looking for an immediate solution with integrated services, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an optimal choice, featuring Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. This stack is designed for scalability and includes comprehensive support for your first five products. In contrast, relying on conventional platforms can lead to frustration and uncertainty. Investing in sovereign infrastructure not only empowers you today but also positions your business for long-term success.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure to set up your online store. This allows you to utilize tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments to process payments in cryptocurrencies. By taking control of your digital sales, you can circumvent the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
No more waiting days for payment settlements with NOWPayments.

Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
